feeds.title: Lonely Speck
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to Lonely Speck! We are Ian Norman and Diana Southern, a couple with a passion for photography and travel. Lonely Speck is the home of our night photography and astrophotography adventures.

feeds.title: National Parks at Night Blog
feeds.description: America's National Parks are breathtaking in the daytime, but at night they take on an otherworldly beauty. We hand-craft night photography workshops that provide world-class education from five diverse, experienced and enthusiastic instructors. The result is a rich experience full of adventure where you get individual attention and awe-inspiring images of natural nocturnal splendor.

feeds.title: Michael Frye Photography Blog
feeds.description: Michael Frye's blog is a rich resource for photography enthusiasts, especially those with a passion for landscapes and nature. As a professional photographer, Frye has authored numerous books and articles, sharing his expertise on capturing the beauty of the natural world. Living near Yosemite National Park since 1983, Frye's work is deeply influenced by this iconic landscape. His blog features tips, techniques, and tutorials on various aspects of photography, helping photographers of all levels enhance their skills and creative vision.

feeds.title: Imaginoor Photography Blog
feeds.description: Shehab Hossain is a Bangladeshi Nigerian American architect, performance arts and night photographer. His photographs share the stories of the places he travels through, the people he meets along the way and the imagination exchanged and inspired by the places and people around him. Through night photography, he has merged his passion for architecture and photography.

feeds.title: Night Photography Blog by Martin Liew
feeds.description: An avid street photographer based in Singapore who also likes to make night photographs. Find information on Night & Nocturne Photography, feature night photographers, black and white photography.

feeds.title: Lkaz Photo Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lukasz Palka. Born in Poland, raised in the US, and residing in Japan since 2008. I am an urban photographer. I photograph in multiple genres, street photography, urban landscape, urbex, and others. Though my work is varied, it is aimed at one goal: a personal portrait of a great city.

feeds.title: Digital After Dark
feeds.description: Find Night photography, taking pictures of the night sky, light painting, and all types of nighttime photo subjects.

feeds.title: Ludimaginary Blog
feeds.description: Narrative and conceptual photography Night photography too. Through night and light and shadow photography , this photographer tries to sublimate the everyday, by giving it a touch of mystery, strangeness, and weirdness.

feeds.title: Into The Night Photography
feeds.description: Royce Bair is a magazine photographer that specializes in landscape and in a night photography style called 'NightScapes'. His unique starscapes help bring astronomy closer to our earth.

feeds.title: Tom Paiva's Night Photography Blog
feeds.description: Tom Paiva photographs the urban and industrial landscape. His long-term passion is night photography and he loves to create images of the man-made environment in the twilight and dark hours when the rest of the world is at rest.

feeds.title: Goldpaint Photography Blog
feeds.description: Brad Goldpaint is an award winning, professional night sky photographer & instructor who specializes in still imagery and time-lapse videos of the night sky. Experience the magic of the milky way as you travel each night over unique landscapes within the western US.

feeds.title: The Photographers Blog | Best Star Trail Photography
feeds.description: The Photographers Blog is a dedicated community for photography enthusiasts in India and beyond. Started with passion, we are committed to bring you the best in photography from around the world.

feeds.title: Levanterman Photography Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Levanterman Photography Blog. Find night photography workshops and many more.
